text: つかまえたかず　＊…　うん　なかなか　がんばって　おるよう　じゃな！

structure.jp: なかなか　がんばって　おるよう　じゃな！
structure.en: it looks like you're working pretty hard!

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: がんばって　おるよう　じゃ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a verb says 'it seems that', a guess from what you can see; じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ. がんばって　おるよう　じゃ = 'it seems you're trying hard'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on; おる is the old-man way of saying いる. がんばって　おる = 'are working hard'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. つかまえたかず = 'the number (you) caught'.
